title: The Annihilation of Beni
subtitle: A Chilling Mystery on a Winter Morning
summary: When the tranquility of Byomkesh’s morning is shattered by unsettling news, a sinister puzzle begins to unfold in the heart of Kolkata. As the world outside teeters on the edge of chaos, Byomkesh Bakshi must pierce the fog of turmoil to uncover a hidden truth. Dive into a gripping detective tale where calm mornings give way to dark secrets.
